sloka: परितुष्टम् मुनिम् ज्ञात्वा गन्धर्वी मधुर स्वरम् ।उवाच परम प्रीता वाक्यज्ञा वाक्य कोविदम् ॥१-३३-१५॥
transliteration: parituṣṭam munim jñātvā gandharvī madhura svaram ।uvāca parama prītā vākyajñā vākya kovidam ॥1-33-15॥

translations.english: Having perceived that the sage was satisfied, the gandharva who was skilled in speech said exceedingly delighted to the sage in a sweet voice.
